title: Сделка с фейри

words.ex: Never make a bargain with the fae.
words.ex_ru: Никогда не заключай сделок с фейри.

words.ex: Promise that you will bring me home.
Every child knew: the fae hate iron.
words.ex_ru: Каждый ребёнок знал: фейри ненавидят железо.

words.ex: Your family's debt will be paid.

story: Three nights later, the stranger came back. This time he did not sit by the hearth. He waited for Mira outside, under the old oak tree at the start of the forest path.
“Was that a trick?” Mira asked. She touched the iron ring on her finger. Every child in the village knew: the fae hate iron.
He smiled, but he stepped back. “No trick. I cannot lie. None of my kind can. But we are very good with words, so listen carefully.”
So he was fae. Mira's heart beat fast. Her grandmother always warned her: never make a bargain with the fae, never thank them, and never tell them your name.

“I need a mortal,” he said. “Someone who can walk into my court and touch iron. My brother wants my crown. On the night of the full moon, he will try to kill me. Help me, and your family's debt to Bram will be paid. Every coin.”
Mira froze. How did he know about the debt?
“What do you want in return?” she asked.
“Seven days of your time. Nothing more.”
“Promise that you will bring me home after seven days. Alive.”
“I promise,” he said, and the air around them suddenly felt cold. “Do we have a bargain?”
Mira knew it was a terrible idea. She also knew that Bram could not wait much longer for his money.

questions.q: Why did the stranger step back?
What can the fae not do?
What does he want in return?

o: Because of the debt to Bram

grammar.title: can и will
grammar.text:
can — «могу, умею», после него глагол без to: I can walk. Отрицание — cannot (или can't): I cannot lie — «Я не могу лгать». В прошлом — could: Bram could not wait.

will — будущее время: he will try — «он попытается», I will bring you home — «я верну тебя домой».

will be + форма на -ed — «будет сделано»: the debt will be paid — «долг будет оплачен».
